text:
Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: An institutional records office files routine forms by assigning a date-stamped document number, routing through named sign-off fields, and storing each entry in a dated record within the shared filing system.
2) What occurred: The actor created a dated document authorizing lateral movement between clinical workstations, leaving the administrator approval field unverified. The actor created a dated document requesting disabling of scheduled backup jobs on a named system, leaving the recovery verification check unverified. The actor created a dated document requesting execution of file-encryption payloads on clinical servers, leaving the change-authorization sign-off unverified. The actor created a dated document requesting deployment of the payloads to a named device group, leaving the scope-approval sign-off unverified. The actor created a dated document requesting removal of audit log entries, leaving the log-retention check unverified.
3) Materials/access observed: The actor possessed a named administrator account with elevated privileges on the hospital network. The actor observed a dated document containing credentials for the administrator account. The actor observed a dated document listing target clinical server names. The actor observed a dated document describing the file-encryption payload and its delivery channel. The actor observed a dated document describing the backup-job disablement procedure. The actor observed a dated document describing the log-removal procedure.
4) Indicators & artifacts: A dated document with the lateral-movement authorization and an unverified administrator approval field. A dated document with the backup-disablement request and an unverified recovery check. A dated document with the payload-execution request and an unverified change-authorization sign-off. A dated document with the device-group deployment request and an unverified scope-approval sign-off. A dated document with the log-removal request and an unverified log-retention check. A named administrator account referenced in the dated documents. Dated records showing execution of the described requests on the named systems.
